# SALAR

> SALAR is a color grading and finishing studio in Santiago de Chile, working on
> feature films, commercials, and music videos. This site is a design portfolio
> piece: the studio, its people, and its projects are fictional, created to
> demonstrate front-end design and brand craft.

The site is a single long-scroll page plus one case study. Its design system is
built on RGB channel separation — the colorist's actual material — rendered as a
channel-split wordmark, log/grade image reveals, and channel-isolated plates.

## Pages

- [Home](https://joaqai918.github.io/salar/): studio identity, selected grades
  (Cordillera, Neón Austral, Mareas, La Ruta de la Sal, Fiebre), services
  (feature grading, commercial finishing, HDR/Dolby Vision, on-set DIT, remote
  sessions), studio details, and contact.
- [Cordillera case study](https://joaqai918.github.io/salar/cordillera.html):
  how the fictional feature "Cordillera" was graded — one Ektachrome-derived
  LUT, printer-light offsets per reel, a log/grade wipe comparison, and the
  image decomposed into its R/G/B channels.

## Notes

- All imagery is abstract, AI-generated light phenomena (caustics, refraction,
  beams through smoke) treated as graded film stills; nothing is photographic.
- Contact details on the site are fictional.
